Today, a bit warmer for the feels like temperature (up 4.2°C) and outside temperature (up 3.6°C) and more moisture-laden outside humidity (up 9%) and rainfall (up 3.6 mm).

The past week and month had observable variation in cloud levels (up 613 m), inside temperature (up 2.7°C), dew point temperature (down 1.7°C), and rainfall (down 3.3 mm) when compared to today.
